records.name: Celani constantan Cu–Ni–Mn air-flow AHE (2019)
records.description: JCMNS 29 near-miss exploratory hydrate. Best air-flow result: AHE over 12 ± 2 W on 100 µm constantan (Cu55Ni44Mn1) wire in D2 at 1 bar, Pin 90 W; wire broke within ~1 day. Same-sentence ±2 W is method-indetermination / raw uncorrected air-flow class — not literature_reported total σ_Q. Stable 6–7 W (200 µm, Xe–D2) reported without ±. EMP contested; does not close EQ-OPEN-YIELD-01.

parameters.host_note: Constantan Cu55Ni44Mn1 wire; nickel-class host for lattice presets. Carbon-class cells are separate.
